requirements.title: Application login
requirements.summary: Registered user will log into the application and based on the login name the user will be recognized either as a student or a teacher

stakeholders_and_interests: student: intends to log into the application
teacher: intends to log into the application
constraints: Users' account already exists - not possible to sign in a new account
preconditions: User is on the UIS homepage
No other user is logged in - the upper bar has a black colour and on the right side there is a visible Login option of the menu
scenario.trigger: User selects the Login option from the menu located on the right side of the upper bar
main_success_scenario: User will select the Login option from the menu located on the right side of the upper bar
Specific Login Page form will appear
User will fill his/her login name that already exists (=is registered in the UIS)
User will enter `pass` in the password field - the universal password for all users
User will press the Login button
postconditions: UIS determines whether the user is either a student or a teacher by checking the users' login name
Login option disappears from the top bar menu
Clickable first and last name of the logged-in user appear in the upper bar on the right
Logout option appears in the upper bar on the right
User with student's status sees a Student's view menu, the upper bar is orange
User with teacher's status sees a Teacher's view menu, the upper bar is dark green
Overview page appears to both Student and Teacher

alternative_flows.label: 5a
alternative_flows.title: 5a. Selected login name does not exist in the UIS
postconditions: User is not redirected from the Login Page
Error message regarding an unsuccessful login attempt appears

alternative_flows.label: 5b
alternative_flows.title: 5b. User enters other password than a `pass`
postconditions: User is not redirected from the Login Page
Error message regarding an unsuccessful login attempt appears

related_information: Information regarding all registered users can be displayed by clicking on the Database Contents reference from the UIS homepage
If another user needs to be added to the UIS it has to be done by importing data file into the DB (option Export/Import DB on the upper bar)

notes: Alternative flows are tracked separately and do not block full coverage by default.
This default policy can be overridden per requirement later if needed.
